summary: ExchangeRight Income Fund, a non-traded Maryland REIT operating as ExchangeRight Essential Income REIT, filed an 8-K updating the status of its continuous private placement of up to $2.165 billion of common shares across eight classes. As of August 31, 2026, 19,957,946 shares had been issued for total capital raised of $546,749,000, with no Class S or Class ER-S shares sold. The board declared August dividends of $0.1449 per share, paid September 15, 2026, with 9.2% reinvested through the DRIP. Routine capital-raising and dividend disclosure; no special-situation transaction, no price or premium terms, and no risk-arb angle.
